top_choice_rationale: P002 recognises a clean prediction-then-discovery chain: Bistritzer and MacDonald's 2011 flat-band prediction at a magic angle, followed by the Jarillo-Herrero group's 2018 observation of correlated insulating and superconducting states. The phases have since been reproduced by many independent groups and extended to other moire platforms, so the discovery is secure even though the pairing mechanism is open. The prize would honour a new class of tunable quantum materials, not a further order of magnitude on a recognised metrology line. The citation naming the Jarillo-Herrero group handles the first-author and parallel-group (Cao, Dean, Yacoby, Young) attribution limit as well as three names allow. P001 is a defensible and cleaner two-name award with a longer record, so it is my second choice; an award this year is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for any proposal on this slate (B046 and B041 credited names have no documented link to me); my Chalmers and WACQT circuit-QED ties would bear only on circuit QED (B031) and trapped ions (B018), which are not on the slate.
